responsibility: Implements the compiler’s compile-time function evaluation layer by tying together const-semantic queries, the concrete CTFE interpreter machine, and the query pipeline that executes MIR for constants and statics. The module classifies which items and functions are const-relevant, runs and validates evaluations with the CTFE machine’s compile-time memory and recursion rules, converts results into compiler constant representations and valtrees, and centralizes CTFE-specific errors, diagnostics, and shared helper/re-export infrastructure used by the rest of the compiler.
